services.desc: COVID-19 STRESS BUSTERS: Story time with Reel Time Fishing Charters & Marine Tours. Shortly before I started my own fishing charter business, a friend and fishing guide gave me some good advice. He said, “Turk, be careful you don’t turn something you love into something you hate.” Knowing he had been in the business for many years, I took his advice seriously. So before investing tens of thousands of dollars into my own boat and gear, I worked for a number of charter companies on the West Coast of Vancouver Island. It turned out to be a wise decision. blurb: Guests join Captain Turk on fishing charters or scenic and wildlife tours in the coastal waters around Nanaimo. Fishing charters are available in four, six, or eight hour durations targeting species like Chinook salmon. Scenic tours include three distinct historical, scenic, and wildlife routes departing from Nanaimo Harbor.

quotes.text: You can be sure of choosing the best guide when going fishing with Turk at Reel Time West Coast Fishing Charters. He always puts a lot of effort to make sure you bring home some great fish but as well the memories of an amazing fishing experience. Turk is a great listener, attentive to detail and persistent when it comes to getting the fish or offering you the best experience. Whether you want him to teach you tips and tricks or simply relax and reel in some fish onboard, Turk will be the perfect guide for you. I can’t wait to go again and catch more fish and have a good time with Turk.

Peter Kingma, Abbotsford I just thought I should drop you a note and express my thanks for a memorable three days this past July. John and I will never forget the hours spent with you in the stunning seascape off the west coast of Vancouver Island. Getting close to the ocean, to you and to a lot of fish was a rich experience and one I will not forget. Your energy and love of your work—if it can be called work—was contagious. You were made for this, my friend. I have high hopes for you as you start your own charter business: Reel Time Fishing Charters. I will definitely be back.

Mike Johnson Medicine Hat, Alberta Turk set us up with an amazing trip away from Alberta. He knows all hot spots on the island – best of all he knows how to find fish, and fast! We had fish on within seconds of setting up and landed a total 35 fish with 11 double headers. His ability to target each species is uncanny, a true gift. He does more than catch you fish, he teaches you how to fish. His respect for the sport and zest for life are something we will not soon forget – we are already planning trips for the next 2 years.

I’ve been fishing the Fraser River for 36 years and have yet to catch fish like I did with Turk on Reel Time Fishing Charters. Turk knew where to go and how to hook me up with fish. My trip was an also an education on the local sites. And for someone who is concerned about safety and comfort, Turk’s seamanship along with his boat (Hourston) provided an enjoyable trip that I will never forget. Looking forward to doing it again!
